_comment: Vietnam Railways (Đường sắt Việt Nam) night trains, read by scripts/adapters/vnr.mjs.

A train is kept when its timetable runs through a night (it leaves on one day and arrives on a later one) and takes at least `minMinutes`: every such VNR train carries sleeper coaches (Nằm khoang 4/6 giường), and a day train or a commuter hop drops out on its own, so a new night train is picked up without editing this file. `exclude` lists numbers to leave out anyway.

MR1/MR2 (Gia Lâm–Beijing West, through sleeping cars) pass the night-train test and are excluded for now: most of their run is China Railway's, whose Beijing–Nanning trains this map already draws from 12306, and a VNR row reaching Beijing would file Chinese stations under Vietnam's hubs.

Station positions: OpenStreetMap's railway stations, matched by name near where this file expects them (refreshed weekly with the track, osm-vnr-track.json). Until a station has an OSM match it sits at `anchors` (a position published for the town's station, `approx`) or, for a station with no anchor, at a point interpolated by its kilometre post between the two nearest anchored stations on the same train — which is why the anchors include the stations where the line bends (Hương Phố, Đồng Lê, La Hai, Ninh Hoà). Replace an anchor with an official position whenever a source carries one.

pairs._comment: Return train per outbound train where it is not the next number up (VNR numbers a pair n / n+1, odd from Hà Nội). SNT and SPT are numbered from the south: SNT1 runs Nha Trang → Sài Gòn, SNT2 the other way, so n / n+1 holds for them too.

frequency._comment: Days a train runs, by number prefix, where VNR runs it every day. A train not listed here keeps no frequency: its row then says it does not know rather than claiming Daily.

service._comment: The name a train runs under, by number prefix, printed before its number on cards (`lineName` stays the number VNR sells it under).

stationNames._comment: Timetable spellings → the one name the map uses (VNR's site writes a few stations both ways).

anchors._comment: Positions of the town's station as published in public references, not from a VNR feed (VNR publishes none).
